name: rectangular_plate_four_holes
description: A rectangular mounting plate with four identical circular through holes near the corners.
source_license: Project-authored example; not from an external dataset.
derived_by: Hand-authored from validated Prompt2ParametricCAD eval JSON.
construction_plan: Create a rectangular base extrusion on the XY plane.
Use one circular cut operation with four positions instead of four separate cut operations.
Place the holes symmetrically inside the plate boundaries.
Use depth "through" for holes that pass completely through the plate.
notes: Repeated identical holes should usually share one cut operation with multiple positions.
Keep hole centers far enough from the edges that the holes stay inside the solid.
